description: This file defines the LinkingController class which manages linking, unlinking, and interaction logic among notes, files, and tags within a web application. It handles entity linking, UI state (such as panels), and navigation actions related to linking functionalities.

classes.name: LinkingController
classes.description: A controller class managing linking and unlinking of notes, files, and tags within the web application, including UI state and navigation.

methods.name: setServicesPostConstruction
methods.description: Assigns the controllers for item list, files, and subscription after construction.

methods.name: get isEntitledToNoteLinking
methods.description: Returns whether the user is entitled to link notes based on subscription status.

methods.name: get activeItem
methods.description: Returns the currently active item from the application.

methods.name: getFilesLinksForItem
methods.description: Retrieves files linked and linking to a given item, with sorting and link creation.

methods.name: getLinkedTagsForItem
methods.description: Retrieves tags linked to the specified item.

methods.name: getLinkedNotesForItem
methods.description: Retrieves notes referencing the specified item.

methods.name: getNotesLinkingToItem
methods.description: Retrieves notes that are referencing the specified item.

methods.name: activateItem
methods.description: Activates a given item by opening appropriate UI panels or navigating accordingly.

methods.name: unlinkItemFromSelectedItem
methods.description: Unlinks an item from the currently selected item.

methods.name: ensureActiveItemIsInserted
methods.description: Ensures that the active item is inserted into the view if needed.

methods.name: linkItems
methods.description: Links two items, handling different item types and linking logic.

methods.name: linkItemToSelectedItem
methods.description: Links an item to the currently selected item.

methods.name: createAndAddNewTag
methods.description: Creates a new tag and adds it to the active item.

methods.name: addTagToItem
methods.description: Associates a tag with a note or file, optionally linking to parent folders.
